name: Pace AI
description: Pace is the context layer for your sales pipeline. It pre-computes deal intelligence from your CRM, emails, and call recordings, then serves it to your AI assistant as live, structured context on every deal. Ask what's really going on with an account, get AI risk and forecast assessments backed by evidence, catch deals that have gone quiet, and know precisely where your team is going to land. No more digging through Salesforce or HubSpot, no more guessing.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pace AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pace AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.pacehq.ai/mcp-server. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pace AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pace AI lists 21 MCP tools, including discover_custom_fields, draft_sales_email, get_account_details, get_assessment, get_call_recordings, get_forecast_change_analysis, get_forecast_evaluation, get_forecast_stats, get_open_todos_for_opportunities, get_opportunity_details, get_org_context, and get_recent_emails.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pace AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Pace AI in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Pace AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pace AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pace AI is developed by Pace. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
